The two small leaves maintain their turgidity and light green coloration. No significant change in morphology or soil condition. Lighting is slightly improved.
The leaves appear subtly less turgid and possibly slightly paler compared to previous frames. Their posture remains upright. Soil still appears damp. Overall image brightness is significantly higher.
The two leaves show clear signs of reduced turgidity, appearing somewhat shriveled and duller in color. The overall plant vigor seems diminished. Lighting is significantly darker again.
The plant material is almost entirely obscured by extreme darkness. It is visually indeterminable whether the leaves are still present or what their current state of health is.
A single stem with one larger, ovate, dark green leaf is propagating in water. The leaf appears healthy and turgid. Concentric rings are visible on the water surface.
The single leaf and stem maintain their healthy appearance and turgidity. Water level and surface appearance are consistent. Lighting is slightly improved.
The leaf appears to have slightly shifted position, and the stem seems to be leaning more into the cup. Turgidity still appears good. Overall image brightness is significantly higher.
The leaf shows reduced turgidity, and the stem appears to be collapsing further into the water, indicating stress. Lighting is significantly darker again.
The plant material is completely obscured by extreme darkness. It is visually indeterminable whether the leaf and stem are still present or what their current state of health is.

visual_health_inference.P2_Mexican_Mint: Based on visible frames ([EARLIEST] to [T-1]), the plant transitioned from healthy and turgid to showing clear signs of reduced turgidity and diminished vigor by [T-1]. Its current health status is visually indeterminable due to extreme darkness.
visual_health_inference.Unmonitored_Money_Plant: Based on visible frames ([EARLIEST] to [T-1]), the plant transitioned from healthy and turgid to showing reduced turgidity and stem collapse by [T-1]. Its current health status is visually indeterminable due to extreme darkness.
visual_health_inference.overall_trend: A concerning trend of declining visual health was observed for both plants from [T-2] to [T-1]. The extreme darkness of the final image prevents a conclusive assessment of their current state, but the preceding frames suggest a period of stress or decline.

anomalies.description: The lighting conditions fluctuate dramatically and erratically across the sequence, from dark to bright to extremely dark. This is inconsistent with a 'Fixed Camera LED (cool spectrum) + Diffuse light from a North window' setup, suggesting issues with camera exposure control or external light interference beyond the described 'diffuse light'.
A prominent blue light streak is visible at the bottom left of the [CURRENT] image, which was not present in any preceding frames. Its origin is unknown.

vision_report.narrative_description: The chronological audit reveals a concerning trend in the visual health of both monitored specimens, culminating in an almost complete loss of visual data in the final frame. From the initial baseline, both the Mexican Mint (P2) and the Money Plant showed stable turgidity. However, by [T-2], subtle signs of reduced turgidity began to manifest in the Mexican Mint. This decline became more pronounced by [T-1], with both plants exhibiting clear signs of stress, including reduced leaf turgor and a noticeable collapse of the Money Plant's stem into its water propagation vessel. The most significant observation is the dramatic and inconsistent lighting across the sequence, which severely hampers a definitive health assessment, particularly in the [CURRENT] image where both plants are rendered visually indeterminable due to extreme underexposure. A novel blue light streak anomaly is also present in the final image. While the registry suggests specific plant types, the visual evidence from [T-2] to [T-1] points towards a period of stress or decline for both specimens, though their ultimate fate in the current state cannot be ascertained visually.
